description: This file defines types and functions for handling outbound reply payloads, including normalization, media URL resolution, chunking, and sending media or text messages in a messaging SDK.

methods.name: normalizeOutboundReplyPayload
methods.description: Normalizes a loose payload object into a structured OutboundReplyPayload with optional text, media URLs, and reply ID.

methods.name: createNormalizedOutboundDeliverer
methods.description: Creates a deliverer function that normalizes payloads before passing them to a handler.

methods.name: resolveOutboundMediaUrls
methods.description: Returns an array of media URLs, preferring mediaUrls array over single mediaUrl.

methods.name: resolvePayloadMediaUrls
methods.description: Resolves media URLs from a sendPayload context payload.

methods.name: countOutboundMedia
methods.description: Counts the number of media URLs in a payload.

methods.name: hasOutboundMedia
methods.description: Checks if a payload contains any media URLs.

methods.name: hasOutboundText
methods.description: Checks if a payload contains text, with optional trimming.

methods.name: hasOutboundReplyContent
methods.description: Checks if a payload has sendable text or media.

methods.name: resolveSendableOutboundReplyParts
methods.description: Normalizes reply payload into a sendable shape with trimmed text and media info.

methods.name: resolveTextChunksWithFallback
methods.description: Returns chunks of text, falling back to full text if chunks are empty.

methods.name: sendPayloadWithChunkedTextAndMedia
methods.description: Sends media payloads or chunks text payloads, handling media first.

methods.name: sendPayloadMediaSequence
methods.description: Sends media URLs sequentially.

methods.name: sendPayloadMediaSequenceOrFallback
methods.description: Sends media URLs or falls back to a default result.

methods.name: sendPayloadMediaSequenceAndFinalize
methods.description: Sends media URLs and then finalizes.

methods.name: sendTextMediaPayload
methods.description: Sends a payload with text and media URLs, chunking text if needed.

methods.name: isNumericTargetId
methods.description: Detects if a string looks like a numeric target ID.

methods.name: formatTextWithAttachmentLinks
methods.description: Formats text with attachment links appended if media URLs exist.

methods.name: sendMediaWithLeadingCaption
methods.description: Sends media items with only the first media having a caption, handling errors.

methods.name: deliverTextOrMediaReply
methods.description: Delivers a reply as media or text, prioritizing media.

methods.name: deliverFormattedTextWithAttachments
methods.description: Delivers formatted text with attachment links.
